source: AWS Open Data Terrain Tiles (terrarium, Mapzen; SRTM/other public DEMs), z12 3x3 mosaic, fetched 2026-09-17
format: bin: int32 nx, int32 ny, float32[nx] x_m (east), float32[ny] y_m (north, row order top->bottom), float32[ny*nx] z_m relative to site
